author: (Tåning, 1928)

note.en: A small lanternfish of 90 to 800 m that lives in deep water; recorded in the region from deep sampling only.
note.es: Un pez linterna pequeño de 90 a 800 m que vive en aguas profundas; registrado en la región solo por muestreo profundo.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic
recWhy: Only a FishBase country listing; open-ocean or deep species, no local record.
